cases.requirement: 完成财富顾问名下客户的T+1资产加工。输出客户、持仓市值、可用现金、总资产和证券数量；金额保持两位小数。请根据表结构补全当前草稿。

code.sql:
WITH advisor_clients AS (
  SELECT client_id
  FROM accounts
  WHERE advisor_id = '{{advisor_id}}'
),
cash_agg AS (
  SELECT 
    client_id,
    SUM(available_cash) as total_available_cash
  FROM cash
  WHERE trade_date = '{{trade_date}}'
  GROUP BY client_id
),
positions_distinct AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    position_id,
    client_id,
    security_code,
    market_value
  FROM positions
  WHERE trade_date = '{{trade_date}}'
),
position_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    client_id,
    SUM(COALESCE(market_value, 0)) as holding_market_value,
    COUNT(DISTINCT security_code) as security_count
  FROM positions_distinct
  GROUP BY client_id
)
SELECT 
  ac.client_id,
  COALESCE(ps.holding_market_value, 0) as holding_market_value,
  COALESCE(ca.total_available_cash, 0) as available_cash,
  COALESCE(ps.holding_market_value, 0) + COALESCE(ca.total_available_cash, 0) as total_assets,
  COALESCE(ps.security_count, 0) as security_count
FROM advisor_clients ac
LEFT JOIN position_stats ps ON ac.client_id = ps.client_id
LEFT JOIN cash_agg ca ON ac.client_id = ca.client_id

         SUM(COALESCE(market_value, 0)) AS holding_market_value,
         COUNT(DISTINCT security_code) AS security_count
  FROM distinct_positions
  GROUP BY client_id
),
cash_summary AS (
  SELECT client_id,
         SUM(COALESCE(available_cash, 0)) AS available_cash

)
SELECT a.client_id,

       COALESCE(cs.available_cash, 0) AS available_cash,
